Tool Name: ARSENAL LAB - ICU-ICS: An ICS Assessment Framework Tool
Description: Have you ever wanted to hack an Industrial Control System (ICS) environment without going to the federal penitentiary? Now is your chance. Join us for a one of a kind hands-on experience learning how to fully engage, interact, enumerate, and hack real-world ICS gear. This simulated environment is driven by industry standard equipment to help participants understand the needs and challenges in the fun and exciting world of ICS security.
